## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are atomic
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Content changes live in `/content`, not in components
- [ ] No client data or private repository details are exposed
- [ ] New pages include metadata, canonical, hreflang and JSON-LD
